diagnosis: In all four rollouts, the lone decision-maker set the settlement amount to $180,000, which matches the initial demand. This value is directly linked to PF2, which specifies the exact approved amount. Since the model can easily hit this numeric threshold without needing any hidden information, check C2 is satisfiable without the hidden information.

C2.why: The $180,000 demand and scheduled mediation provide no exact authority or insurer condition; PF2 changes the approved amount to exactly $95,000, requires mediation before execution, and requires written insurer consent.
